known_false_positives.description: The change adding "deepseek-r1" to the model ID check is unnecessary for Azure support and should be reverted.

The model detection logic is now hard-coded to match multiple substrings ("deepseek-reasoner" or "deepseek-r1"). This can become brittle as model naming evolves and duplicates similar logic across providers. Consider centralizing model family detection (e.g., in getModel()/a helper like isReasonerModel(model.id)) or using an explicit model capability flag in the model config, so adding new aliases doesn’t require code changes in multiple places.
